jei.simplehammers.info.area: Mines the 3x3 area in front of you (Radius: 5x5, Break Through: more layers, Override: other blocks too). Sneak to mine one block.
jei.simplehammers.info.reshape: Sneak and hold use to carve the aimed octet off a block: the rest becomes stairs, a slab or octets (with Simple Octets). Constructor's Touch (SimpleBuilding) turns slabs back into stairs and stairs into blocks.
jei.simplehammers.info.crush: Right-click a diamond block or cracked diamond block nine times (iron tier or better): 81 diamond pebbles. A quartz block gives 4 quartz in 4 strikes.
jei.simplehammers.info.upgrade: Hold use on a block with its upgrade material in the off hand: the in-world upgrades of the Simple mods (crucibles, furnaces, chests ...) go up a tier, strike by strike.
tip.simplehammers.sledgehammer: Mines 3x3. Sneak + hold use: carve off an eighth
jei.simplehammers.note.reshape.how: Sneak and hold use: carves the aimed octet off
simplehammers.guide.page.1.title: Simple Hammers
simplehammers.guide.page.1: Seven sledgehammers that mine a whole area, carve and reshape blocks, crush diamond and quartz blocks and upgrade blocks in the world strike by strike, and their three enchantments.
simplehammers.guide.page.2.title: Sledgehammers: mining a whole area
simplehammers.guide.page.2: Seven sledgehammers from Stone to Enderite. Each mines like a pickaxe of its tier, but one swing takes the 3x3 area in front of you along; sneaking mines just the aimed block.
simplehammers.guide.page.3.title: Sledgehammers: mining a whole area
simplehammers.guide.page.3: Bigger areas take longer: the first block costs 1.5 times a same-tier pickaxe, blocks 2 to 9 another 0.8 each, every further block 0.7.
simplehammers.guide.page.4.title: Carving and reshaping
simplehammers.guide.page.4: Sneak and hold use on a block: after a short charge the hammer knocks the aimed octet (an eighth) off it. The rest becomes the slab, a stair or - with Simple Octets - the material's octets;
simplehammers.guide.page.5.title: Carving and reshaping
simplehammers.guide.page.5: blocks without stairs or octets stay as they are.
simplehammers.guide.page.6.title: Crushing diamond and quartz blocks
simplehammers.guide.page.6: Right-click a diamond block or a Cracked Diamond Block nine times with an iron-tier hammer or better: it breaks into 81 Diamond Pebbles (config diamondBlockPebbles).
simplehammers.guide.page.7.title: Crushing diamond and quartz blocks
simplehammers.guide.page.7: A quartz block breaks into 4 quartz in 4 strikes.
simplehammers.guide.page.8.title: In-world upgrades with the hammer
simplehammers.guide.page.8: Hammer in the main hand, the upgrade material in the off hand, hold use on an upgradable block:
simplehammers.guide.page.9.title: In-world upgrades with the hammer
simplehammers.guide.page.9: one strike per second (5 by default), the last one turns it into the next tier with its contents.
simplehammers.guide.page.10.title: In-world upgrades with the hammer
simplehammers.guide.page.10: Which blocks go up is SimpleLib's data type in_world_upgrades - every Simple mod ships its own (crucibles,
simplehammers.guide.page.11.title: In-world upgrades with the hammer
simplehammers.guide.page.11: furnaces, beacons, SimpleBuilding's chests, hoppers and pistons).
simplehammers.guide.page.12.title: Hammer enchantments
simplehammers.guide.page.13.title: Hammer enchantments
simplehammers.guide.page.13: Radius makes the area 5x5, Break Through (I-II) takes one more layer behind the face per level, Override (I-II) takes other blocks along - level I every pickaxe block, level II everything breakable, and the hammer then
simplehammers.guide.page.14.title: Hammer enchantments
simplehammers.guide.page.14: also harvests axe, shovel and hoe blocks at its full speed.
simplehammers.guide.page.15.title: A tool in the crafting grid
simplehammers.guide.page.15: A shapeless recipe with a sledgehammer gives the hammer back with 1 durability less instead of using it up; a hammer that breaks doing so is gone.
simplehammers.guide.page.16.title: Sledgehammers at the anvil
simplehammers.guide.page.16: Two sledgehammers combine for 1 level: both durabilities plus 12 % of the maximum, enchantments merged like vanilla (incompatible ones from the right hammer are dropped).
simplehammers.guide.page.17.title: Sledgehammers at the anvil
simplehammers.guide.page.17: With its repair material a damaged hammer mends one eleventh per piece for 1 level per piece (+1 for a new name, at most 39). Hammer results never raise the repair cost.
simplehammers.guide.page.18.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplehammers.guide.page.18: The seven sledgehammers, the enchantments Break Through, Override and Radius, the ten hammer recipes and their recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplehammers.guide.page.19.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplehammers.guide.page.19: Old worlds load them under simplehammers:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids.
simplehammers.guide.page.20.title: Creative tabs
simplehammers.guide.page.20: Own tab with the seven hammers, the guide and the three enchanted books.
simplehammers.guide.page.21.title: Creative tabs
simplehammers.guide.page.21: Without SimpleBuilding each hammer also sits behind the hoe of its tier in the Vanilla tools tab (switch addItemsToVanillaTabs).
simplehammers.guide.page.22.title: Commands
simplehammers.guide.page.22: /simplehammers config shows and changes every option of config/simplehammers-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplehammers.guide.page.23.title: Commands
simplehammers.guide.page.23: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simplehammers.guide.page.24.title: Settings
simplehammers.guide.page.24: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
